language.name: Sunbeam News Nightly
language.rationale: This design language balances the authoritative and calm nature required for public-broadcast evening news with Sunbeam's warm, optimistic, and approachable brand identity, using brand colors to establish a distinct and readable on-air presence.

notes: structure and spacing: platform-owned (airy density - 33/46px padding, 16px line gap, at scale 1)
accent: a rule across the top of the panel, one clear space above the words
motion: glide at measured pace → preset mask-wipe
